How this works

  • 47 questions. No timer — work at your own pace.
  • Exhibits are shown inline. Click any exhibit to enlarge it.
  • Multi-answer questions say so and use checkboxes; they score all-or-nothing.
  • 26 questions are drag-and-drop or dropdown types from the real exam. Type your answer, reveal the official one, then mark yourself.
  • Nothing is saved when you close the tab.
